theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (ω₁ ω₂ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (e : Rn n) (s : ℝ) (ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ), (∀ φ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, ω₁ x (fderiv ℝ φ x) = ∫ x in U, ω₂ x (fderiv ℝ φ x)) → ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → (∀ y ∈ tsupport ζ, y + s • e ∈ U) → ∫ y, ω₁ (y + s • e) (fderiv ℝ ζ y) = ∫ y, ω₂ (y + s • e) (fderiv ℝ ζ y)
